notes.title: Cooking Up Progress! 🍳✨

notes.title: Save System Complete + Next Steps
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41907546/89ed25cd4ce49438b33c17727946f9ebfd95dff3.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, everyone!
[/p][p]In the first announcement, I shared an overview of what we already have in the game and what we plan to implement. From now on, I want to focus on more specific updates: what we’ve just completed and what’s coming next. That way, you can follow the development more closely and suggest more targeted improvements!
[/p][p]📌 What’s just been completed:[/p][p]We’ve finished the game’s save system!
This type of game requires a lot of information to be saved quickly and in an organized way, and I’m really happy with the result. You can now save and load games reliably!

[/p][p]🎯 What’s next:[/p][p]We’re working on revamping the Steam artwork, the user interface, and the game’s overall visual presentation. The goal is to make everything more polished so we can release an official trailer soon! This will give you an even better sense of how the game is shaping up.
[/p][p]Thanks for the support![/p][p]💚 Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, join our Discord group, and follow the weekly devlogs!

[/p][p]See you next week![/p]

notes.title: We're Back! Devlog Series Starts Now for Our Restaurant Management Game
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41907546/06ed699a93e77172d408d68b503451b9afb3b12f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]After a long break (yes... 3 years 😅), I'm officially back working on our restaurant management game! Development is in full swing again, and I'll be posting weekly updates here on Steam to keep you updated. I promise I won't stop this time.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's do a quick recap of what the game is and where we left off:[/p][p]🍽️ What is this game?[/p][p]It's a 3D restaurant management simulation where you build, customize, and expand your own restaurant. Think of it as a mix of creativity and complex business strategy.[/p][p]You'll be able to:[/p][p]✅ Build walls, doors, furniture, decorations...[/p][p]✅ Hire and manage specialized staff[/p][p]✅ Create a menu with dishes from various countries[/p][p]✅ Manage finances, inventory, and ingredient logistics[/p][p]✅ Expand your restaurant and unlock new features[/p][p]Each dish has requirements, including ingredients, furniture, and staff skills, and the quality depends on who prepares it (and a bit of luck, too).[/p][p]⚠️ Prepare carefully! If too many customers come and your staff isn't ready, they'll get frustrated and leave.
[/p][p]💡 Features already implemented:[/p][p]Building system[/p][p]Ingredient storage system[/p][p]Menu and staff management[/p][p]Unlock system for upgrades, marketing, loans...[/p][p]Financial overview and ranking logic[/p][p]A star-based progression system
[/p][p]🎯 What's next? My plan is:[/p][p]Save system[/p][p]Land expansion system to expand your restaurant[/p][p]Improve UX/UI[/p][p]Add more customization options[/p][p]Improve AI and customer behavior[/p][p]Balance the economy[/p][p]Image polishing

[/p][p]Sorry for the delay, and thanks for continuing or checking out this project. I'm excited to bring it back to life. Let's make something amazing. I plan to release it by January 2026!
[/p][p]Feel free to add it to your wishlist, join the discord group, and follow all the weekly devlogs.
[/p][p]See you next week![/p]
